phases.objective: Prevent repository automation from converting a Draft PR to Ready and immediately finalizing it, and reject Draft state both in the CI gate and immediately before the merge request.

e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: A Draft PR is blocked before any PUT /pulls/{number}/merge request, including a Ready-to-Draft race after the initial CI gate.
steps: Build a passing required-check set for an exact protected-main pull request candidate.
Prove the CI gate returns blocked when the candidate is Draft.
Prove a candidate that becomes Draft after the gate is rejected by the final pre-merge readback.
Prove automatic pr_delivery and full_workstream plans no longer include mark_ready immediately before pr_finalize.
assertions: Draft state is included in structured CI-gate evidence.
A final Draft readback throws github_pr_finalize_draft_blocked.
No merge endpoint request is issued after the Draft race.
Mark-ready remains available only as a separately invoked capability and is absent from automatic finalize templates.

phases.objective: Require exact-head human approval, final head/base identity readback, and an explicitly issued capability envelope before protected pull-request finalization.

e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: Protected finalization reaches the merge endpoint only after exact-head human approval quorum and a final exact head/base identity readback; automatic capability renewal is blocked.
steps: Resolve the exact candidate head and base through the required CI gate.
Re-read the pull request immediately before merge and reject state, Draft, head, or base drift.
Read bounded pull-request reviews and require the latest exact-head decisive review from non-bot, non-author human reviewers.
Reject stale approvals, bot or author approvals, active changes-requested decisions, and incomplete review evidence before the merge endpoint.
Require a separately issued capability envelope for pr_delivery, full_workstream, and operation resume instead of just-in-time automatic renewal.
assertions: At least one exact-head human approval is required by default.
Stale-head, bot, and author approvals do not satisfy quorum.
Active exact-head changes-requested decisions block finalization.
Final head/base drift fails before review or merge dispatch.
Protected finalization cannot create a just-in-time capability envelope.

phases.objective: Prove concurrency-safe Draft/Ready transitions across workflow retries and merge queues.
Repository lifecycle guard has no provider canary authority.
This patch grants no Production, deployment, or provider authority.
